categoryName: Sports & fitness — cricket, badminton, football, volleyball, athletics, gym & yoga, cycles and repair

skuLines.line: Tennis-ball cricket bat — kids sizes 1-6 (poplar/Kashmir willow)
skuLines.examples: FLX/Decathlon Kids Bat Size 1, Cosco Poplar Kids Bat, SG Kashmir Willow Junior, local Jalandhar poplar bat
skuLines.seasonality: Session start (Mar-Apr) and IPL window Mar-May; dead in monsoon Jul-Sep
skuLines.marginBand: 40-60% on unbranded poplar, 20-30% on branded MRP
skuLines.notes: Size ladder is the whole trick — a 5,000-strong 5-18 school needs sizes 3-6 deepest. Poplar cracks in dry cold; store off the floor, monsoon damp warps blades.

skuLines.line: Tennis-ball cricket bat — adult (Kashmir willow / heavy-tennis)
skuLines.examples: FLX T500 Max, SG Kashmir Willow, Cosco Wooden Bat, MRF Champ
skuLines.notes: Tennis-ball gear outsells leather-ball gear roughly 10:1 at mass retail — stock this deep, English willow shallow.

skuLines.line: English willow bat — leather ball, senior/junior
skuLines.examples: SG Sunny Tonny, SS Ton Player, MRF Genius Grand, FLX Junior English Willow
skuLines.notes: High-value slow stock — run it on a pre-order/indent book instead of holding hill-freighted inventory.

skuLines.line: Cricket tennis balls — hard/heavy, pack of 6
skuLines.examples: Cosco Cricket Tennis Ball, Vicky Hard Tennis, Guru Hard Cricket Tennis Ball, Nivia Heavy Tennis
skuLines.packSizes: Loose single, pack of 6, box of 12
skuLines.notes: The single highest-repeat SKU in the whole category — balls get lost over walls and into nullahs. Never go out of stock; rubber hardens if stored in cold sun-facing shelves.

skuLines.line: Rubber / soft-cricket / wind ball for juniors
skuLines.examples: Cosco Cricket Rubber Ball, Vicky Wind Ball, Nivia Soft Ball
skuLines.notes: Safe ball for the 5-10 cohort; the PE department buys in dozens.

skuLines.line: Leather cricket ball — 2-pc / 4-pc practice and match
skuLines.examples: SG Club, SG Test, Cosco Leather Ball, BDM Turf
skuLines.notes: Leather mildews in a 3-month monsoon — keep in a dry sealed bin with silica, not open racking.

skuLines.line: Stumps set — wooden/plastic with bails and base
skuLines.examples: Cosco Wooden Stumps Set, Vicky Plastic Stumps with Spring Base, SG Wooden Stumps
skuLines.packSizes: Set of 6 stumps + 4 bails; spring-base single set
skuLines.notes: Bulky low-value — freight-inefficient per rupee; ship with a bicycle/net consignment.

skuLines.line: Batting pads + batting gloves (junior/youth/men)
skuLines.examples: SG Club Pads, Cosco Batting Legguard, SS Match Gloves, FLX Batting Gloves
skuLines.notes: Sweat-damp gloves rot in a closed monsoon store — sell with the message to air them.

skuLines.line: Protection — abdominal/L guard, thigh pad, arm guard, chest guard
skuLines.examples: Cosco Abdominal Guard, SG Combo Thigh Pad, Vicky Arm Guard
skuLines.notes: Small, light, high-margin — ideal hill-freight economics. Non-negotiable for leather-ball nets.

skuLines.line: Cricket helmet with steel grille
skuLines.examples: SG Polyfab, Shrey Star, Cosco Cricket Helmet, Forma Test Plus
skuLines.notes: A school liability item — do not substitute an unbranded shell. Bulky, ships poorly.

skuLines.line: Wicket-keeping gloves + inners
skuLines.examples: SG Club Keeping Gloves, Cosco Keeping Gloves, SS Cotton Inners
skuLines.notes: One or two pairs per campus team — depth of 2, not 20.

skuLines.line: Bat care & repair consumables — grips, grip cone, anti-scuff, toe guard, linseed oil, binding tape
skuLines.examples: Cosco Bat Grip, SG Chevron Grip, Vicky Anti-Scuff Sheet, SG Bat Oil
skuLines.packSizes: Single grip, pack of 2/3, 100ml oil, roll of tape
skuLines.notes: Cheapest, fastest, highest-margin line in cricket and the anchor for a bat-repair service. Almost zero freight cost.

skuLines.line: Cricket kit bag — duffel and wheeled
skuLines.examples: SG Ecopak, Cosco Kit Bag, SS Kit Bag with Wheels, FLX Cricket Bag
skuLines.notes: Volumetric freight is the killer — nest smaller bags inside larger on inbound.

skuLines.line: Badminton racket — aluminium/steel entry (school & recreational)
skuLines.examples: Cosco CBX 410, Li-Ning XP 60-IV, Yonex GR 303, Silver's Pro-170
skuLines.packSizes: Single, pair-in-box set with 2 rackets + shuttle
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; hard spike in monsoon Jul-Sep and winter Dec-Feb when outdoor play stops
skuLines.notes: Badminton is the sport a cold, wet hill campus actually plays 12 months. Twin-racket boxed sets are the single best-selling item shape here.

skuLines.line: Badminton racket — graphite/carbon mid-range
skuLines.examples: Yonex Voltric Lite 40i, Li-Ning G-Force 5900 Superlite, Li-Ning Air Force 78, Yonex Nanoray Light
skuLines.notes: Where the volume has moved. Li-Ning undercuts Yonex 15-25% at the same spec — carry both so the price-shopper doesn't leave campus.

skuLines.line: Badminton racket — premium/pro
skuLines.examples: Yonex Astrox 88D/100ZZ, Li-Ning Axforce 90, Yonex Arcsaber 11
skuLines.notes: Thin margin and heavy online discounting — 2-3 pieces on display, rest on order.

skuLines.line: Nylon shuttlecocks — tube of 6
skuLines.examples: Yonex Mavis 10/350, Cosco Aero 727, Li-Ning A+300, Silver's Marvel
skuLines.notes: Consumable with real repeat. Nylon survives damp and cold far better than feather — make this the default stock and the feather line the exception.

skuLines.line: Feather shuttlecocks — tube of 10/12
skuLines.examples: Yonex Aerosensa 20/30, Li-Ning Turbo Charge, Victor Master No.3
skuLines.notes: Feathers warp and go brittle in cold damp air and break in minutes if stored wrong — humidity-controlled storage or don't carry it. Shortest effective shelf life in the category.

skuLines.line: Racket service consumables — overgrips, replacement grips, strings, racket covers
skuLines.examples: Yonex AC102 Overgrip, Li-Ning Cushion Grip, Yonex BG65 string, Cosco racket cover
skuLines.notes: Tiny, light, high-margin, and the input to a restringing service — the highest ROI line on the shelf.

skuLines.line: Nets and posts — badminton, volleyball, throwball, TT
skuLines.examples: Cosco Volleyball Net Nylon, Cosco Badminton Net, Nivia Volleyball Net, Vinex Nylon Net
skuLines.seasonality: Session start and post-monsoon court rebuild (Oct)
skuLines.notes: Institutional purchase by the PE department, not by residents. Nylon nets rot after a full monsoon outdoors — annual replacement is a predictable indent.

skuLines.line: Football — rubber moulded, sizes 3/4/5
skuLines.examples: Cosco Rubber Football, Nivia Kross World, Vector X Rubber Football
skuLines.seasonality: Post-monsoon Oct-Feb; poor in heavy rain
skuLines.notes: Rubber moulded survives stony hill ground; hand-stitched does not. Size 4 for 8-12, size 5 for 13+.

skuLines.line: Football — hand-stitched synthetic / match
skuLines.examples: Nivia Shining Star, Nivia Storm, Cosco Torpedo, Vector X Ultra
skuLines.notes: Stitching opens up on wet gravel — sell alongside the pump and warn about pressure.

skuLines.line: Volleyball — rubber and synthetic
skuLines.examples: Cosco Acclaim, Nivia Super Synthetic, Cosco Volley 18 Panel, Mikasa (premium)
skuLines.seasonality: Post-monsoon; volleyball is the default staff-and-student evening game on a hill campus
skuLines.notes: Cheapest team sport to run — one ball, a net, any flat patch. Highest play-hours per rupee of any line here.

skuLines.line: Basketball — sizes 5/6/7
skuLines.examples: Cosco Dribble/Funtos, Nivia Engraver, Spalding NBA (premium)
skuLines.notes: Needs a hard court — depth depends entirely on whether the campus has one.

skuLines.line: Ball inflation kit — hand/foot pump, needles, pressure gauge
skuLines.examples: Cosco Ball Pump, Nivia Air Pump, Vector X Double Action Pump, needle pack of 5
skuLines.packSizes: Single pump; needles in packs of 3/5/10
skuLines.notes: A flat ball is dead stock and a dead evening — the needle is the ₹30 item that saves a ₹1,500 sale. Never out of stock.

skuLines.line: Team-sport protection — shin guards, goalkeeper gloves, mouth guard
skuLines.examples: Nivia Shin Guard, Cosco GK Gloves, Vector X Shin Pads
skuLines.notes: Light and high-margin; 1-2 GK glove pairs per campus is enough.

skuLines.line: Training bibs, marker cones, house sashes, tug-of-war rope
skuLines.examples: Vinex Training Bibs, Cosco Marker Cone set of 6, Vinex Tug of War Rope
skuLines.packSizes: Bibs set of 6/12; cones set of 6/10
skuLines.seasonality: Sports day / annual athletic meet (Oct-Dec) and PE session start
skuLines.notes: Pure institutional line — sells to the PE department on an indent, not walk-in.

skuLines.line: White canvas / PT school shoes
skuLines.examples: Sparx Kids School Shoes, Relaxo Flite PT, Bata Naughty Boy, Liberty Gliders school canvas
skuLines.seasonality: Hard spike at session start and after every vacation return; steady replacement all year
skuLines.notes: For a uniformed residential school this is the highest-unit-volume sports SKU that exists. Size-curve depth beats brand choice; carry white polish/whitener alongside.

skuLines.line: Sports/running shoes — value tier
skuLines.examples: Sparx SM series, Campus Crysta/Battle, Action Nitro, Bata Power
skuLines.notes: The workhorse tier for students and staff. Sizes 6-9 turn fastest; keep a size-run, not a brand-run.

skuLines.line: Sports/running shoes — branded tier
skuLines.examples: Puma/Adidas/Nike entry runners, Asics Contend, Decathlon Kalenji Run Active
skuLines.notes: The wallet that leaks off-campus most often — a 30-50 km trip to town is usually for shoes. Even a shallow 6-8 pair display stops that leak.

skuLines.line: Sports socks — ankle, crew, school white, cushioned
skuLines.examples: Bonjour Sports Socks, Jockey Ankle, Nivia Football Stockings, Decathlon Kipsta socks
skuLines.packSizes: Single pair, pack of 3, pack of 6
skuLines.notes: Highest-repeat apparel SKU on a residential campus — laundry loss is constant. Multipacks only; light, cheap freight.

skuLines.line: Sportswear — dry-fit T-shirt, shorts, track pants/lower
skuLines.examples: Decathlon Domyos/Kalenji tees, Nivia Dry-Fit, Shiv Naresh track pant, HRX tee
skuLines.notes: Athleisure crossover — bought as daily wear far more than as sportswear, so it moves at grocery-like frequency. Modest cuts and full-length lowers matter on a Sikh institutional campus; avoid short shorts and sleeveless as core stock.

skuLines.line: Track suit / training jacket — winter
skuLines.examples: Shiv Naresh Track Suit, Nivia Track Suit, Decathlon Domyos zip jacket, Sport Sun track suit
skuLines.seasonality: Sharp Oct-Feb peak — Rajgarh/Baru Sahib winters make this a survival item, not a sports item
skuLines.notes: Biggest single seasonal bet in the category for a cold hill campus. Buy the winter range by Sep; it is dead by Mar and ties up cash if over-bought.

skuLines.line: Thermal base layer / compression skins
skuLines.examples: Decathlon Kalenji base layer, Boldfit compression tee, Neva/Lux Cottswool thermal
skuLines.notes: Overlaps the clothing lane — decide once which counter owns it so it isn't double-stocked.

skuLines.line: PE/officials kit — whistle, stopwatch, measuring tape, relay batons, marking lime, scoreboard
skuLines.examples: Vinex whistle, Vinex digital stopwatch, Freemans 30/50m tape, Vinex relay baton set
skuLines.notes: Institutional, low value, very high margin; a single indent covers the year.

skuLines.line: Athletics throws & jumps — shot put, discus, javelin, hurdles, high-jump crossbar
skuLines.examples: Vinex school shot put 3/4/5kg, Vinex discus 1kg, Vinex school javelin, Vinex hurdles
skuLines.notes: Heavy metal on a 30-50 km hill road — freight is a real line item. Order once a year with the meet indent, never speculatively.

skuLines.line: Medals, trophies, ribbons, certificates, engraving
skuLines.examples: Local trophy-house acrylic/metal trophies, Vinex medals, satin ribbon sashes
skuLines.seasonality: Annual meet, inter-house, prize-day (Oct-Dec, plus Mar)
skuLines.notes: Best margin in the whole category and a guaranteed annual institutional order. Attach engraving as a service.

skuLines.line: Yoga mat — 4mm/6mm PVC/TPE/NBR
skuLines.examples: Boldfit Yoga Mat 4mm & 6mm, Cosco Yoga Mat Fit 6mm, Strauss NBR mat, Decathlon Domyos mat
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; New-Year and session-start spikes; indoor spike in monsoon
skuLines.notes: Yoga is core practice at a Kalgidhar Trust campus — treat as a staple, not a fitness fad item. Bulky roll; ships nested. Cheap PVC mats crack in cold.

skuLines.line: Yoga mat — premium with carry bag/strap
skuLines.examples: Boldfit TPE mat with cover bag, Wellsville TPE, Decathlon Domyos Grip+
skuLines.notes: Staff and faculty tier; 3-5 pieces is plenty.

skuLines.line: Yoga props — blocks, strap, bolster, wheel, knee pad
skuLines.examples: Boldfit Yoga Block, Strauss Yoga Belt, Kosha yoga bolster
skuLines.notes: Small attach items to the mat sale; light freight.

skuLines.line: Resistance bands — loop set, tube with handles, therapy band
skuLines.examples: Boldfit Resistance Band, Cosco Stretch Band 5-pc set, Strauss Loop Bands, Aurion tube set
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; indoor spike in monsoon and winter
skuLines.notes: Almost weightless — the ideal hill-freight fitness SKU. Latex perishes: 18-24 months, keep out of sun and cold.

skuLines.line: Skipping rope — PVC, steel-wire, ball-bearing, counting
skuLines.examples: Boldfit Skipping Rope, Cosco Skipping Rope, Strauss Speed Rope, digital-counter rope
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; the default indoor cardio when it rains for weeks
skuLines.notes: Cheap, tiny, high-margin, breaks often, everyone from an 8-year-old to a staff member buys it. Should be at the counter, not on a back rack.

skuLines.line: Dumbbells — PVC/vinyl/neoprene pairs 1-10 kg
skuLines.examples: Lifelong PVC Dumbbells 5kg, Slovic PVC set, Kore PVC pair, Cosco vinyl dumbbell
skuLines.notes: Heaviest rupee-per-kilo problem in the category — freight on a 30-50 km hill road can eat the margin. Stock 1-5 kg only; sell heavy plates to order.

skuLines.line: Home-gym weights — plates + rod set, kettlebell, adjustable dumbbell
skuLines.examples: Kore PVC 20kg home gym set, Lifelong 20kg combo, Boldfit kettlebell 4-8kg
skuLines.notes: Order-book item for married-staff quarters. Never hold speculative stock — freight plus dead capital.

skuLines.line: Small fitness tools — push-up bars, hand grip, ab roller, ab wheel, twister, jump/step
skuLines.examples: Boldfit Hand Grip Strengthener, Strauss Ab Roller, Cosco push-up bar, Aurion twister
skuLines.notes: High margin per gram of freight; strong impulse line for hostel rooms.

skuLines.line: Lifting accessories — gym gloves, wrist wraps, weight-lifting belt
skuLines.examples: Boldfit Gym Gloves, Tynorgrip Gym Gloves, Strauss lifting belt, Aurion wrist wrap
skuLines.notes: Attaches to any campus-gym user; light and compact.

skuLines.line: Recovery — foam roller, massage ball, spike ball, massage gun
skuLines.examples: Boldfit Foam Roller, Strauss grid roller, Fitkit massage gun
skuLines.notes: Massage guns carry a battery — check courier/transport rules on lithium cells for the hill leg.

skuLines.line: Braces & supports — knee cap, ankle, elbow, wrist, back belt
skuLines.examples: Tynor Knee Cap, Vissco ankle binder, Flamingo elbow support, Frido knee support
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; injury-driven, spikes with tournament season
skuLines.notes: With 5,000 residents and no market within 30-50 km, a sprain at 8pm has nowhere else to go — this is a genuine must-have. Overlaps the pharmacy counter: crepe bandage and pain-relief spray (Volini/Moov) sit there and need a drug licence, supports do not.

skuLines.line: Sipper, shaker and steel sports bottle
skuLines.examples: Boldfit shaker 700ml, Cello Puro sipper, Milton Steel Bottle 750ml, Decathlon 800ml bottle
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; steel insulated spikes in winter
skuLines.notes: Loss-and-breakage item on a residential campus; insulated steel sells far better than plastic in a cold climate.

skuLines.line: Gym / sports bag — duffel, drawstring, backpack
skuLines.examples: Boldfit gym bag, Nivia kit bag, Wildcraft duffel, Decathlon 20L sports backpack
skuLines.notes: Volumetric freight; nest on inbound.

skuLines.line: Gatka equipment — soti (39" stick), farri (shield), practice gear
skuLines.examples: National Gatka Association standard soti 39"/500g, wooden/leather farri, sikhaccessories.com and khalsastore.com gatka items
skuLines.packSizes: Single stick; single shield; pair sets
skuLines.seasonality: Gurpurab and Hola Mohalla display season, sports meet, and year-round training
skuLines.notes: This is the one line a generic sports assortment misses and a Kalgidhar Trust campus cannot be without — gatka is taught and displayed at Akal Academy campuses. Sourced from Punjab (Amritsar/Ludhiana) Sikh-articles suppliers, not from Cosco/Nivia distributors, so it needs its own vendor. Wooden soti splits — check for cracks before sale.

skuLines.line: Kabaddi / wrestling / indigenous games kit
skuLines.examples: Vinex kabaddi mat, kabaddi shoes, wrestling singlet, Nivia mat
skuLines.notes: Mats are institutional-only and freight-heavy; shoes and singlets are the retail-able part.

skuLines.line: Table tennis — bats, balls, net-and-post set
skuLines.examples: Stiga/Cosco TT bats, Cosco/Stiga 1-star & 3-star balls, Cosco retractable TT net
skuLines.packSizes: Bat single or pair set; balls pack of 6/12; net single
skuLines.seasonality: Strong monsoon (Jul-Sep) and winter (Dec-Feb) indoor spike
skuLines.notes: Indoor games carry a hill campus through the weeks when nothing outdoor is playable. Balls are the repeat consumable; bats and rubbers are the upgrade sale.

skuLines.line: Indoor games — carrom board, coins, striker, powder; chess; ludo
skuLines.examples: Precise/Surco carrom board, Synco coins, boric powder, Cosco chess set
skuLines.seasonality: Monsoon and winter; hostel common-room purchases
skuLines.notes: Boundary with the toys/stationery lane — the boards and coins fit naturally at a sports counter; decide ownership once. Boric powder and strikers are the repeat SKUs, and a warped board in monsoon damp is unsellable, so store flat and dry.

skuLines.line: Bicycle — kids 12"/14"/16"/20" single speed
skuLines.examples: Hero Blaze/Miss India kids, Avon kids cycle, BSA Champ, Ninety One kids
skuLines.notes: Married-staff families with small children are a real cohort here. Comes semi-assembled in a carton — needs an assembly bay, which is exactly what makes the repair service pay. Freight and floor space are the constraints, so keep 3-5 units and take orders.

skuLines.line: Bicycle — adult roadster/city 26"
skuLines.examples: Hero Jet Gold, Atlas Goldline, Avon Sports 26T, BSA Photon
skuLines.notes: On a closed township, a cycle is transport, not sport. But steep hill gradients mean single-speed roadsters underperform geared cycles here — sell honestly or you get returns.

skuLines.line: Bicycle — geared MTB 26"/27.5"
skuLines.examples: Hero Sprint Pro, Ninety One MTB, Firefox Bad Attitude, Btwin Rockrider (Decathlon)
skuLines.notes: The right cycle for 1,400m hill roads and the aspirational student purchase. High ticket, slow turn — run it on a pre-order/group-buy book, and pair with a graduation buy-back board.

skuLines.line: Tyres and inner tubes — 12" to 27.5"
skuLines.examples: Ralco/Duro/MRF bicycle tyre 26x1.95, Hero tube 26", Ninety One tyre
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; post-monsoon spike after gravel and pothole damage
skuLines.notes: Rubber cracks in cold and perishes in sunlight — store indoors, rotate stock, don't hang tubes in a window. This is the line that decides whether a resident can keep riding or must go to town.

skuLines.line: Puncture repair consumables — patch kit, rubber solution, tyre levers, valve/rim tape
skuLines.examples: AWESOME puncture repair kit, Grand Pitstop patch kit, IceToolz tyre repair kit, generic vulcanising solution
skuLines.packSizes: Kit; 10-patch pack; 22ml solution tube; lever pair
skuLines.notes: Highest-margin, highest-repeat, lowest-freight line in the cycles group. Rubber solution has a real shelf life (~18-24 months) and dries out once opened — date-rotate it.

skuLines.line: Cycle pump — floor, frame, mini
skuLines.examples: Hero foot pump, Ninety One floor pump with gauge, Beto mini pump, Duro hand pump
skuLines.notes: Keep a shop floor pump free-to-use at the door — it is the cheapest footfall generator in a township with no other cycle shop.

skuLines.line: Cycle spares — brake shoes & cables, chain, freewheel, pedals, bearings, spokes, saddle, grips, gear shifter
skuLines.examples: Hero/Atlas genuine spares, Shimano Tourney derailleur/shifter, KMC/Rolex chain, generic brake shoe pair
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; brake and chain wear spikes on hill descents and after monsoon
skuLines.notes: Brakes and chains wear far faster on 1,400m gradients and wet gravel than on plains — the fast-mover mix here is not the same as a plains shop's. This is the true must-have depth in the cycles group, ahead of complete cycles.

skuLines.line: Cycle accessories — bell, mudguard, carrier, stand, mirror, bottle cage, phone mount, seat cover
skuLines.examples: Hero cycle accessories, Cradiac accessories, Ninety One mudguard set, generic bell
skuLines.notes: Full mudguards are near-essential in a heavy-monsoon hill posting — a pre-monsoon push in Jun sells the whole shelf.

skuLines.line: Cycle lighting & visibility — rechargeable front/rear LED, reflectors, reflective tape/vest
skuLines.examples: USB rechargeable front light 1200mAh, Cradiac tail light, reflective spoke strips, hi-vis vest
skuLines.seasonality: Peak Oct-Feb — early dark, fog, and unlit hill roads
skuLines.notes: A genuine safety must-have here, not an accessory: unlit hill roads plus winter fog plus blind curves. Lithium cells — check transport rules and don't store in freezing outdoor godown.

skuLines.line: Cycle lock — cable, combination, D-lock
skuLines.examples: Godrej cycle lock, generic spiral combination lock, Ninety One D-lock
skuLines.notes: Even in a closed campus, hostel cycle mix-ups drive steady demand.

skuLines.line: Cycling helmet — kids and adult (ISI-marked)
skuLines.examples: Ninety One cycling helmet, Btwin/Decathlon helmet, Vega cycling helmet
skuLines.notes: Insist on a BIS/ISI-marked shell — a school-township customer base makes a cheap unmarked helmet a real liability. Bulky, ships badly; nest inside cycle cartons.

skuLines.line: Cycle maintenance & tools — chain lube, grease, degreaser, cleaning brush, spanner set, chain tool, allen keys
skuLines.examples: Motul C1 chain clean/C2 lube, WD-40, IceToolz chain tool, generic cycle spanner set
skuLines.packSizes: 200-400ml spray; tool kit single; spanner set
skuLines.notes: Wet monsoon plus stony hill roads rust drivetrains in weeks — this line is why a cycle survives here. Aerosols are flammable: store away from heat and declare on transport.

skuLines.line: Pickleball starter set — paddle + ball
skuLines.examples: Boldfit pickleball paddle, Decathlon Artengo/Kuikma paddle, Cosco pickleball set, generic composite paddle + 3 balls
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; introduce post-monsoon when courts dry
skuLines.notes: The fastest-growing racket sport in India (1,200+ courts by H1-2025; players projected 60k→1M by 2028). Needs only a badminton-sized court, so a campus can adopt it cheaply. Start with 2-4 value paddle sets — a demand test, not a bet.

skuLines.line: Trekking & outdoor — rucksack, trek pole, insulated flask, headlamp
skuLines.examples: Decathlon Quechua 20L/30L rucksack, Wildcraft daypack, Quechua trek pole, Milton insulated flask, headlamp
skuLines.notes: A Himachal hill campus runs treks and outdoor camps — this reads as adjacent but is genuinely local demand. Bulky; buy shallow and specific to the campus excursion calendar.

trends2026: Pickleball is the fastest-growing racket sport in India — ~1,200 courts by H1-2025, three-to-four new courts added every few weeks in metros, players projected from ~60,000 (2024) to ~1 million by 2028; the money right now is in cheap starter paddle sets and value paddles, not premium gear

Quick commerce has formally entered sports: Blinkit and Zepto now run Sports & Fitness categories (roughly ₹50-₹3,000, brands including Cosco, Boldfit, Yonex, Adidas, boAt). Even where 10-minute delivery cannot reach a hill township, it resets the price residents expect — a captive store gets compared against a Blinkit screenshot

Athleisure crossover is now the volume driver, not sportswear demand: dry-fit tees, track pants and track suits are bought as everyday clothing. The India sports apparel/activewear segment is growing faster than equipment, and on a residential campus this is the single biggest rupee line in the category

Li-Ning has taken the mid-price graphite badminton racket from Yonex by undercutting 15-25% at the same spec (G-Force 5900 ~₹2,490, Air Force 78 ~₹2,999 vs Yonex Voltric Lite 40i ~₹1,999 and up); the ₹1,200-3,500 carbon racket is where badminton volume has moved

Home and hostel-room fitness has stuck post-COVID — mats, resistance bands, loop bands, adjustable dumbbells and skipping ropes. India's sports & fitness goods market is put at USD 2.5-5.2 bn in 2025 growing 5.4-7.4% CAGR to 2034-35, with the accessory tier outgrowing hard equipment

Khelo India and Fit India (plus Khelo India Winter Games, directly relevant to Himachal) keep pushing school and college-level participation, which turns institutional equipment into a predictable annual budget line rather than an ad-hoc purchase

Smart/connected fitness at the cheap end — counting skipping ropes, sub-₹2,000 fitness bands and smartwatches — is now the entry fitness purchase for students, and it sits next to the mat rather than in electronics

Tennis-ball / box cricket has effectively become its own market: hard-tennis-ball-specific bats and hard tennis balls outsell leather-ball equipment by roughly an order of magnitude at mass retail, and the IPL window (Mar-May) is the demand spike
adjacentServices: Cycle repair and service bay — puncture, brake and gear tune, wheel truing, chain replacement, annual service. Labour margin is 70-90%, the parts attach at 35-55%, and with the nearest market 30-50 km of hill road away this is the single strongest reason a resident walks in. It also gives the spares shelf a reason to exist

Cycle assembly and pre-delivery inspection — kids' and adult cycles arrive semi-assembled in cartons; charging for assembly and a first free service converts a 10-15% dealer margin into a real per-unit contribution
Cycle rental / hourly hire for students, visitors and parents on campus visit days, plus a graduation buy-back and second-hand board so departing students' cycles resell instead of leaving campus

Badminton racket restringing and re-gripping — minutes of labour on a ₹50-200 consumable, ₹150-600 a job, and the highest-frequency service attach a hill campus generates because badminton plays year-round indoors

Cricket bat service — knocking-in, oiling, grip change, anti-scuff and toe-guard fitting, minor binding repair; turns a ₹40 grip into a service ticket and extends the life of an expensive bat nobody can easily replace
Shoe repair, resole and stud replacement — with PT shoes as the campus's highest-volume SKU and no cobbler-plus-stock alternative nearby, repair captures the value between replacements

Team and house kit printing — name-and-number jersey printing, house bibs, screen printing and sublimation for sports day and inter-house events; a seasonal service the school pays for out of the event budget
Trophy and medal engraving for the annual athletic meet, inter-house and prize day — the highest-margin institutional order in the category, and engraving makes it defensible against online buying

Institutional indent supply to the school and university PE departments — a quarterly or annual requisition for balls, nets, athletics throws, marking lime, bibs and cones; predictable, planned, and it lets slow bulky stock be bought against a confirmed order instead of on speculation

Deposit-based equipment issue-and-return (a PE 'lending library' for bats, balls, rackets, gatka soti) — turns one asset into recurring revenue, keeps breakage accountable, and serves the students who cannot afford to own
Pre-order / group-buy book for high-ticket, freight-heavy items — geared MTBs, English willow bats, home-gym weight sets — so hill freight and dead capital are only committed against a paid order

Court and ground services — net repair and replacement, court marking and lining, ball inflation and pressure checks, post-monsoon ground and court restoration (a real annual job in a heavy-monsoon location)
Campus gym equipment maintenance contract — cable, pad, bearing and lubrication servicing for the institution's own gym, plus consumable resupply
